architecture_snapshot.perception_upstream_ci_scope_note: WP708/WP710/WP711/WP712/WP713 dependencies are recorded resolved only at their declared repository-hosted component-CI scopes; final physical Perception Fabric acceptance remains false

consolidated_architecture.principle: Keep the existing two logical browser Perception Fabric sources and make the physical adapter thin, capability-negotiated, version-bound and provenance-strict. Do not add another browser subsystem or authority.

rendered_source.continuous_candidate: Page.startScreencast only after exact browser/CDP capability acceptance
rendered_source.flow_control: CDP maxFramesInFlight/ack is transport backpressure only; F2 PerceptionCaptureBroker remains local admission/drop authority
rendered_source.time: screencast Network.TimeSinceEpoch remains auxiliary; F2 monotonic receipt/admission time remains local ordering authority

structural_source.default_candidate: AX full/depth-bounded/partial/query capture for interaction semantics
structural_source.escalation: DOMSnapshot when exact DOM attributes, layout/style/rectangles, AX ambiguity or explicit downstream evidence contract requires richer structure

shared_provenance: auxiliary browser timestamp with explicit clock domain when retained
consolidated_architecture.generation: navigation, target replacement, detach/reconnect or invalidating protocol restart advances source generation before observations re-enter temporal fusion
consolidated_architecture.identity_guard: Target.SessionID and Page.screencastFrame.sessionId must never share one field/meaning
consolidated_architecture.simultaneity_guard: shared target/session does not prove rendered/structural simultaneity; existing temporal fusion and uncertainty govern correlation
consolidated_architecture.authority_guard: browser adapter produces candidate observations only; broker, canonical state and EffectGate/EffectJournal authority are unchanged

external_primary_facts: Tip-of-tree CDP changes frequently and has no guaranteed backwards compatibility; exact protocol capability must be bound.
Page.startScreencast is experimental and exposes event-stream controls including everyNthFrame, maxFramesInFlight, acknowledgement and a sendLastFrame performance/latency trade.
Page.captureScreenshot exists in stable 1.3 and provides a pull fallback.
Accessibility exposes semantic AX role/name/value/state with bounded/partial/query retrieval; Accessibility.enable warns of possible performance impact.
DOMSnapshot exposes full DOM plus layout and selected style/rectangle information.
falsifiers: If current F2 gains an equivalent typed browser provenance/capability policy before handoff, reclassify this delta as duplicate documentation and do not fork.
If exact-browser measurement shows sampled screenshots dominate screencast on resource use, quality and temporal coverage, make screenshot the default rendered path.
If AX fallback frequency or overhead is high, make DOMSnapshot or a thinner direct DOM projection the structural default.
If rendered/structural skew cannot be bounded under the selected mechanisms, add an explicit synchronization/barrier experiment rather than pretending shared target/session implies simultaneity.
If source-generation fences fail navigation/reconnect stale-data tests, reject the adapter candidate.
measurement_plan: Pin one exact local target browser build and exact CDP protocol/capability surface.

Rendered: compare bounded screencast versus sampled screenshot at matched useful observation rate; record p50/p95 latency, CPU/RSS, encoded bytes/sec, broker accepts/drops, reconnect behavior and quality/task coverage.
Structural: compare AX modes versus DOMSnapshot; record serialized bytes/node counts, p50/p95 latency, CPU/RSS, fallback rate and semantic task coverage including accessibility-poor pages.
Cross-channel: record rendered/structural skew, navigation/source-generation boundaries and stale-fusion rejection.
Permission/revocation: consume existing capture-authstream work rather than creating a second authority lane.
Final acceptance: only the owner-authorized non-synthetic local real-device/OS-permission receipt can close the physical Perception Fabric blocker.

handoff.target: Trigger-4 local Perception Fabric adapter/acceptance lane
integration_order: implement capability-negotiated rendered adapter behind existing source broker
implement selective structural capture behind existing structural source
run existing WP714 non-synthetic local acceptance harness

why_stop_here: The remaining discriminators are exact target-browser/local-runtime measurements. Additional generic external reading has lower information gain than the existing source-backed hypotheses and cannot substitute for the current physical acceptance boundary.
